name_note: GTDB's Mediterraneibacter_A is a split of Mediterraneibacter holding the described species Mediterraneibacter butyricigenes plus two unnamed species, and not the other species kept in Mediterraneibacter.

sentences.text: The described species of this genus, Mediterraneibacter butyricigenes, is a Gram-stain-positive, obligately anaerobic, rod-shaped bacterium whose type strain came from faeces of a healthy male in South Korea.
Its type strain was placed in Clostridium cluster XIVa by 16S rRNA gene analysis and was most closely related to Mediterraneibacter glycyrrhizinilyticus.
The strain produced butyrate as the major end product of glucose fermentation and was assigned to the genus Mediterraneibacter in the family Lachnospiraceae.
A mouse study of two probiotic strains reported enrichment of Mediterraneibacter butyricigenes among taxa linked to gut barrier integrity and metabolic resilience.
